social_data_sync_timeframe.description: The social data (UGCPosts, Shares, Comments) sync time frame in months. Default value: `SIX` .

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your LinkedIn client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your LinkedIn client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
